typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Import Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi via Fontshare CDN or standard @font-face in index.css. Do not use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans.

buttons.secondary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-neutral-100 rounded-none border border-neutral-200
buttons.destructive: bg-[#E63946] text-white hover:bg-[#D62828] rounded-none border border-[#E63946]

component_instructions.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Make it dense. Add 'border-b border-neutral-200' to rows. Sticky header with 'bg-[#F8F8F8] text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-neutral-500'. Align numeric columns right.
component_instructions.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Use monochromatic palettes (blacks, grays) with one accent color (e.g., #000000 for primary bar, #E5E5E5 for secondary). Hide grid lines or make them very faint dashed lines.
component_instructions.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). They look more premium and editorial than default Lucide icons.
component_instructions.modals_dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog. Remove rounded corners. Backdrop should be 'bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-md'.
component_instructions.variants_matrix: For apparel products, build a dense grid showing Size (S, M, L) vs Color. Use small input fields inside the grid cells for quick stock entry.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selects, tabs, specific table rows) MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='vendor-login-button', data-testid='product-row-123').
